consequence.statement: The metric is now exposed as envoy_cilium_npds_update_time rather than envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_time, so queries that use the old name stop matching.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and recording rules to use envoy_cilium_npds_update_time.

original.statement: In Cilium 1.17 the metric envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_time is renamed to envoy_cilium_npds_update_time, so monitoring that queries the old name has to be updated.

decision.reason: [ev-2214fc54500d] lists the rename of `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_time` to `envoy_cilium_npds_update_time` under Changed Metrics. [ev-77f05428497a] says the whole NPDS metrics prefix was renamed. The metric is still exported, just under a new name, so queries that use the old name stop matching. The upgrade notes don't say any workload, resource or setting fails, so a failure kind isn't supported. Behavior-change (review) with low severity and a remediation to update dashboards and alerts fits the evidence.
